result.summary: Adds test vectors to `script_tests.json` covering signature and public key validation edge cases in `src/script/interpreter.cpp`. The new cases test `DERSIG` signature size bounds (minimum 9 bytes, maximum 73 bytes), total-length byte verification, single-byte null R/S handling, and `STRICTENC` public key prefix rules.
result.problem: Boundary conditions in signature and public key encoding verification were missing from the unit test data, allowing synthetic mutants in consensus and policy validation logic to survive undetected.
evidence: Kills six live mutants identified on bitcoincore.space in `src/script/interpreter.cpp` (lines 5168, 5191, 5200, 5232, 5259, 5186), covering consensus checks and an out-of-bounds read guard (PR description).
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to test vectors or commits; rebased with updated commit hashes.
result.card: Adds test vectors to script_tests.json covering signature and public key canonical encoding edge cases in the script interpreter. Mutation testing on bitcoincore.space identified six live mutants surviving in interpreter.cpp, including boundary checks for DERSIG signature length limits, signature total-length byte verification, single-byte null R and S values, and STRICTENC pubkey prefix checks. Four of the covered checks exercise DERSIG consensus rules, one exercises STRICTENC policy rules, and a 3-byte signature test checks the lower-bound guard preventing out-of-bounds reads. No dependencies.

risk.why: Only touches test data in script_tests.json; an erroneous test case would only cause CI or unit test failures without affecting node runtime behavior.
